description: This Java class implements the RetrieveAttributeStrategy, which handles RetrieveAttribute commands within the system. It processes the command by extracting attributes from a Thing object and constructing appropriate results, including error handling if attributes are not found.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributeStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles RetrieveAttribute commands by extracting attributes from a Thing and generating appropriate results.

methods.name: RetrieveAttributeStrategy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the strategy with the RetrieveAttribute class type.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the retrieval logic, extracting attributes and constructing a result based on the presence of the attribute.

methods.name: extractAttributes
methods.description: Helper method that retrieves the Attributes object from a Thing, throwing if the Thing is null.

methods.name: getAttributeValueResult
methods.description: Builds the result containing the attribute value or an error if the attribute is not found.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Computes the previous EntityTag for the command, based on the previous entity.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Computes the next EntityTag for the command, based on the new entity.
